title: SG-4 Build the interface frame kit and design tokens
summary: Design tokens, bundled pixel fonts, generated nine-slice frame PNGs and framed components on the game screen
description: Context: palette (src/lib/palette.ts, 48 colours), art pipeline (src/art/sources.ts, generateAssets, art:generate) and Tailwind exist, but the UI is unframed and only ui/cursor-hand.png exists. Desired behavior: tokens defined once and exposed as CSS vars and Tailwind theme values, fonts from @fontsource, generated nine-slice frames, components using them with a four-state button. Expected result: the game screen uses the kit. Why: shared look for every later component.
acceptance_criteria: Given the palette, when tokens are built, then every colour token equals a PALETTE value and is exposed as a --sf-color-* CSS variable and a Tailwind theme colour
Given art:generate, when it runs, then PNG frames for bar, panel, plaque, parchment card, slot and four button states exist with manifest entries
Given a Button with each state, when rendered, then normal, hover, pressed and disabled classes are present
Given the repo, when searched, then no panel-frame, sound or pointer SVG remains under game/public

in_scope: wiring into header, layout, story panel, suggest trigger

technical_constraints: Phaser stays 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
All art is generated raster pixel art from palette grids; no downloads or CDN
Palette at most 48 colours, defined once
Fonts bundled via npm, not URLs
Unit tests with all dependencies mocked
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered with Act and Verify units green
